svg.title: FIVE REGIONS THROUGH TIME
svg.desc: Divisions, unions, and changing societies in five fictional regions, 1000–2000 Original synthetic history · All periods, events, and relationships are invented. Museum objects are decorative samples; embedded provenance identifies the actual works. One linear year scale. Bridges: succession, division, or union; dotted links: uncertain continuity. Width is compositional, not a quantity. Decorative map: Milner, 1850.
